scene.testo: [Camara] among the worst of the weekend: he lost 9 places compared with his grid slot.
[Camara]: thirteenth in qualifying and twentieth in the race, starting eleventh. Grade *five*.
[Hamilton]: eleventh in qualifying and ninth in the race, starting twentieth. Today he gets *six and a half*.
[Leclerc]: fourth in qualifying and eighth in the race, starting fourteenth. He earns *seven*.
[Antonelli]: third in qualifying and fifth in the race, starting second. We give him *seven*.
[Russell]: second in qualifying and fourth in the race, starting seventh. Grade *eight*.
[Verstappen]: sixteenth in qualifying and second in the race, starting twenty-first. Today he gets *eight and a half*.
And then the best: [Norris]. Pole and win: a perfect weekend. A performance worth applauding. Grade *ten*.
